*Each row is classified by its **least certain component** (overall) and by component. Vocabulary: Confirmed (directly supported by strong observations), Decoded (best-supported reconstruction from several observations), Partial (some behaviour understood, important details remain), Candidate (plausible hypothesis, excluded from the baseline), Unresolved (evidence insufficient). The register keeps the richer Phase A labels; mapping: CONFIRMED to Confirmed, DECODED to Decoded, PARTIAL to Partial, CANDIDATE to Candidate, UNRESOLVED / UNKNOWN / FAILED to Unresolved.*
